rule: Every mandatory production gate and every required check must map to at least one concrete executable provider. A model/mock provider cannot satisfy a real-environment check.

atomic_capability_coverage.blocking_gap: Exact atomic cases must be populated for every operational inventory item. Empty/wildcard coverage is forbidden.

static_security.blocking_gap: CI results must be normalized into static-security.json bound to the exact release SHA.

auth_security.blocking_gap: Real HTTPS OAuth client flow must prove PKCE, redirect/resource binding, scope denial, replay, expiry and refresh rotation.

browser_isolation.blocking_gap: One exact real-Chrome receipt must exercise wrong tab/origin/document/session and all forbidden RAW-CDP/JS/cookie paths.

real_environment_matrix.blocking_gap: Produce a single exact-SHA matrix receipt covering the declared supported WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP, Chrome, MariaDB and MySQL envelope.

upgrade_migration.blocking_gap: Need fresh install, previous-release upgrade, interrupted migration resume, idempotency and persistence proof for settings/jobs/memory/evidence/OAuth/pairing.

transaction_integrity.blocking_gap: Generalize the strong WooCommerce mutation/readback/rollback pattern to every mutating operational capability and emit an exact-SHA receipt.

concurrency_recovery.blocking_gap: Unify real DB collision, lease expiry, fencing, CAS, advisory-lock, crash-window and retry/dead-letter evidence in one receipt.

fault_injection.blocking_gap: Model checking is not live fault injection. Need real DB restart/disconnect, network interruption, remote 429/5xx/timeout, Chrome kill, MV3 suspension and process-kill crash windows.

load_backpressure.blocking_gap: Need a declared real concurrent MCP workload with p50/p95/p99, bounded queue/memory, backpressure and release SLO receipt.

h24_soak.blocking_gap: A real exact-SHA run of at least 86400 seconds is required. The existing nightly-soak workflow is intentionally insufficient.

remote_live_integration.blocking_gap: Need one normalized exact-SHA receipt proving remote HTTPS MCP, real OAuth client, real Chrome pairing, one read and one reversible write.

observability_operability.blocking_gap: Need real alert trigger plus exercised runbook recovery and redaction/audit evidence in one exact-SHA receipt.

backup_restore.blocking_gap: No complete backup/clean-restore production harness was found. Need restore integrity plus measured RPO/RTO.

supply_chain_release.blocking_gap: Normalize pinned actions, dependency locks, SBOM, checksums, attestation and critical-vulnerability result into exact-SHA receipt.

compatibility_degradation.blocking_gap: Need explicit negative environment tests proving unsupported WP/PHP and unavailable browser/provider degrade without synthetic success.

documentation_claims.blocking_gap: Cannot pass until every operational atomic case has internal contract + official source refs and generated release claims derive from the same manifest.
